what: CORNERSTONE #2: a 1:1 copy of every request, change and fix in the vault; what goes in stays in
words: add a backup of every single one of them. not just one incase it gets lost. every request, every change, and every fix has a copied 1:1 file of them to be drawn up if the original is missing or damaged or overridden. no exceptions. what goes in stays in. and doesn’t get removed without express permission and consent.
